scripts.test-vanilla-index: bun --hot src/vanilla-javascript/index.ts &     bun test ./tests/index.e2e.ts      --define 'process.env.SERVER_NAME=vanilla-javascript/index.ts';     kill $(ps aux | grep '[0-9] bun --hot' | awk '{print $2}')
scripts.test-vanilla-broadcast: bun --hot src/vanilla-javascript/broadcast.ts & bun test ./tests/broadcast*.e2e.ts --define 'process.env.SERVER_NAME=vanilla-javascript/broadcast.ts'; kill $(ps aux | grep '[0-9] bun --hot' | awk '{print $2}')
scripts.test-htmx-ws-index: bun --hot src/htmx-ws/index.ts &                bun test ./tests/index.e2e.ts      --define 'process.env.SERVER_NAME=htmx-ws/index.ts';                kill $(ps aux | grep '[0-9] bun --hot' | awk '{print $2}')
scripts.test-htmx-ws-broadcast: bun --hot src/htmx-ws/broadcast.ts &            bun test ./tests/broadcast*.e2e.ts --define 'process.env.SERVER_NAME=htmx-ws/broadcast.ts';            kill $(ps aux | grep '[0-9] bun --hot' | awk '{print $2}')
scripts.test-hono-jsx-index: bun --hot src/hono-jsx/index.tsx &              bun test ./tests/index.e2e.ts      --define 'process.env.SERVER_NAME=hono-jsx/index.ts';               kill $(ps aux | grep '[0-9] bun --hot' | awk '{print $2}')
scripts.test-hono-jsx-broadcast: bun --hot src/hono-jsx/broadcast.tsx &          bun test ./tests/broadcast*.e2e.ts --define 'process.env.SERVER_NAME=hono-jsx/broadcast.ts';           kill $(ps aux | grep '[0-9] bun --hot' | awk '{print $2}')
scripts.e2e: bun run test-vanilla-index; bun run test-vanilla-broadcast; bun run test-htmx-ws-index; bun run test-htmx-ws-broadcast; bun run test-hono-jsx-index; bun run test-hono-jsx-broadcast
